items.title: Intel (INTC) Teams With Lens Technology On AI Chip Packaging
items.summary: Intel (NasdaqGS:INTC) has signed a memorandum of understanding with Lens Technology focused on through glass via (TGV) advanced packaging. The collaboration targets next generation AI hardware, including AI PCs, data center chips, embodied AI robotics, and edge computing platforms. The agreement centers on potential joint work in TGV processes and high precision manufacturing to support Intel’s foundry and advanced packaging offerings.
